title: Locker Rental: deposit, minimum term, cancellation notice and relocation waiver terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the refundable deposit collected at rental start, the minimum commitment length before closure is fee-free, the notice required before a voluntary closure takes effect, the flat fee charged when closure is requested before the minimum term has elapsed, whether that fee is waived for a documented relocation, and the radius beyond which a relocation qualifies for that waiver. The rule governing how these figures are actually applied when a member cancels is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Deposit, term, notice and termination-fee table
| Tier | Deposit | Minimum term | Cancellation notice | Early termination fee | Relocation waiver offered | Qualifying relocation radius |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | $15.00 | 1 month | 15 calendar days | $0 | Yes | 50 miles |
| Medium Locker | $20.00 | 1 month | 15 calendar days | $0 | Yes | 50 miles |
| Large Locker | $25.00 | 1 month | 15 calendar days | $0 | Yes | 50 miles |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | $30.00 | 3 months | 15 calendar days | $20.00 | Yes | 75 miles |
| Day-Use Locker | $0 | 0 months | 0 calendar days | $0 | No | not applicable |
| VIP Locker Suite | $50.00 | 3 months | 15 calendar days | $30.00 | Yes | 75 miles |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- What deposit does a member pay to start a VIP Locker Suite rental? Fifty dollars, refundable.
- Which tiers carry a nonzero early termination fee? Only the Premium Climate-Controlled Locker (twenty dollars) and the VIP Locker Suite (thirty dollars); every other tier's early termination fee is fixed at zero.
- Does the relocation waiver apply to a Day-Use Locker rental? No; this tier does not offer the relocation waiver, and it carries no qualifying relocation radius.
- How many months' minimum commitment applies to a Large Locker rental? One month.

## Points of judgement
A tier whose early termination fee is fixed at zero (Small Locker, Medium Locker, Large Locker, Day-Use Locker) carries no dollar amount that a relocation waiver could offset, since there is no fee to waive; the relocation-waiver figures fixed for those tiers describe only whether and at what radius a waiver would apply if a fee were otherwise due.
